principle: AI diagnosis supports teacher judgement. AI mastery score, suggested TP evidence and teacher-confirmed TP remain separate.

confidence_rules.medium: repeated evidence with limited task/source diversity
confidence_rules.high: clear repeated evidence across independent tasks, sources or dates

evidence_policy.written: usable for reading, writing, grammar and written literary responses
evidence_policy.oral: audio/video or teacher observation required for pronunciation, intonation, pidato and interactive speaking
evidence_policy.audiovisual: required where the targeted skill explicitly depends on audiovisual interpretation
evidence_policy.ocr_uncertain: exclude from confirmed weakness until verified
evidence_policy.teacher_mark: teacher-confirmed correctness takes priority over automatic mark recognition

tp_policy: The system may describe evidence consistent with TP characteristics but must not automatically assign official PBD Tahap Penguasaan.
